Job Title: Junior Software Engineer

Company: Digient Technologies Private Limited

Experience: Freshers

Location: Chennai (Onsite)

Employment Type: Full-Time




About Us

Digient Technologies is a dynamic and innovative B2B online iGaming company, dedicated to providing cutting-edge solutions in the rapidly evolving iGaming industry. We pride ourselves on delivering high-quality products and services that enable our clients to stay ahead in the competitive landscape of online iGaming.




About the Role

We are looking for enthusiastic and motivated Software Trainees to join our AI team. This role is ideal for recent graduates who are passionate about Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and software development.

As a Software Trainee, you will work alongside experienced professionals and gain hands-on experience in developing AI-powered applications while learning about the latest tools and technologies.




Key Responsibilities

Assist in developing AI and Generative AI applications.
Work with Python to develop and maintain applications.
Learn and work with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other large language models (LLMs).
Support API development and integrations using FastAPI.
Participate in software testing, debugging, and documentation.
Research emerging technologies and contribute innovative ideas.
Collaborate with team members to deliver high-quality solutions.



Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
Basic knowledge of Python programming.
Basic understanding of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Generative AI concepts.
Familiarity with APIs and web applications.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong communication and teamwork skills.
Eagerness to learn and adapt to new technologies.

Preferred Skills

Knowledge of Python frameworks.
Familiarity with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar AI tools.
Exposure to Git, databases, and cloud platforms will be an added advantage.



If you are passionate about technology and eager to build a career in Artificial Intelligence, we would love to hear from you.
